summary: Synchronously replace/create a file while preserving Node flags, mode, flush, Buffer/string encoding, and undefined return.

requirements.options_shape: statically known or represented by NodeFsOptions

semantics.mode: only affects a newly created file
semantics.flush: when true, fsync-like flush occurs before return

caveats: File.WriteAllText does not preserve Node open-flag semantics or Buffer behavior.
Mode/permission behavior is OS-dependent, especially on Windows.
If file is an fd, descriptor ownership and current-position behavior must be preserved.

tests.name: replace existing file
tests.expected_behavior: file contains exactly 'new' and the call evaluates to undefined

tests.name: exclusive create flag
tests.expected_behavior: throws a Node-compatible EEXIST-style error when the destination already exists
